mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM favorites join products on products.id = favorites.product_id and products.deleted = 0 WHERE favorites.user_id = #{userId}

SELECT f.id,f.user_id,f.product_id,f.created_at, p.title,p.price,p.original_price,p.sales,p.stock,p.tag,p.skus, s.name shop_name, s.score shop_score FROM favorites f JOIN products p ON p.id = f.product_id AND p.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN shops s ON s.shop_id = p.shop_id WHERE f.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY f.id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{size}
